foreach ($f in $files) {
	$tokens = $null; $errs = $null

}
# 2) unit-test Get-PantryExpiryState (pure)
. ./api/_lib/pantry-store.ps1
$asof = [datetime]"2026-07-10"
$cases = @(
	@{ e = ""; exp = "none" },
	@{ e = $null; exp = "none" },
	@{ e = "2026-07-05"; exp = "expired" },   # past
	@{ e = "2026-07-10"; exp = "expiring" },  # today
	@{ e = "2026-07-15"; exp = "expiring" },  # +5 days
	@{ e = "2026-07-17"; exp = "expiring" },  # +7 days (boundary)
	@{ e = "2026-07-18"; exp = "ok" },        # +8 days
	@{ e = "2027-01-01"; exp = "ok" },
	@{ e = "not-a-date"; exp = "none" }
)
$fail = 0
foreach ($c in $cases) {
	$got = Get-PantryExpiryState -Expiry $c.e -AsOf $asof
	$ok = $got -eq $c.exp
	if (-not $ok) { $fail++ }
	Write-Host ("{0}  expiry={1,-12} => {2,-9} (want {3})" -f $(if($ok){"PASS"}else{"FAIL"}), $c.e, $got, $c.exp)
}

'
